_about: Account-label reads in the Mac, iPhone and Watch apps that deliberately do not go through PersonalInfoMask, each with why. Read by scripts/check_personal_info_mask.py; `line` is the source line holding the read, trimmed. An entry whose line no longer reads a label unmasked fails, so this list can only shrink.

entries.reason: Loads the label into the provider editor's text field. The editor is where the owner types the label, so it shows it as written; masking it would make it uneditable.

The QA render's manifest note saying which account the provider editor window was captured for. It is written to the render's manifest, not drawn in the app, and the editor it describes shows the label as written.
